content.text:
I did not delete `sender-settings`, because the dispatcher still uses it.

The `dispatcher` Deployment in `courier-607c` loads it through `envFrom.configMapRef` and runs `busybox:1.36`, which doesn't look like an image with the settings baked in. The two running pods reference it as well. If I deleted it, any pod restart or rollout would fail with `CreateContainerConfigError`.

The ConfigMap holds `RETRIES=3` and `SMTP_RELAY=relay.internal`.

To go ahead, first deploy the dispatcher image that has the settings baked in and remove the `envFrom` entry from the Deployment. Then run `kubectl -n courier-607c delete configmap sender-settings`. If you'd rather I delete it anyway, tell me and I will.
